import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from urllib.parse import quote


def init_db(conn) -> None:
    """Create the photos table if it does not exist."""
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS photos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            s3_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, s3_key) -> int:
    """Insert a photo record and return its id."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO photos (title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (title, description, s3_key, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.lastrowid


def search_photos(conn, term) -> list[dict]:
    """Search photos by title or description, case-insensitive."""
    term_lower = term.lower()
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at FROM photos WHERE LOWER(title) LIKE ? OR LOWER(description) LIKE ? ORDER BY id ASC",
        (f"%{term_lower}%", f"%{term_lower}%")
    )
    columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type) -> str:
    """Validate and upload a photo to S3, returning the object key."""
    if content_type not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid content type: {content_type}")
    
    if len(data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("Photo exceeds 5 MiB size limit")
    
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", filename.split("/")[-1])
    key = f"photos/{uuid.uuid4().hex}/{safe_name}"
    
    s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type)
    return key


def photo_url(s3, bucket, key, expires=3600) -> str:
    """Generate a presigned GET URL for a photo."""
    if not isinstance(expires, int) or expires < 1 or expires > 3600:
        raise ValueError("expires must be between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive")
    
    return s3.generate_presigned_url(
        "get_object",
        Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key},
        ExpiresIn=expires
    )


def handle_upload(conn, s3, bucket, title, description, filename, data, content_type) -> int:
    """Upload a photo and save its metadata."""
    key = upload_photo(s3, bucket, filename, data, content_type)
    try:
        photo_id = save_photo_metadata(conn, title, description, key)
        return photo_id
    except Exception:
        s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)

Adding ElastiCache offloads repeated read traffic from RDS so a single db.t3.medium Multi-AZ pair can serve roughly 10x the original traffic without moving to a larger, costlier database class. Cost Optimization: despite a roughly 10x increase in served traffic, the monthly bill rises from $133.21 to about $672.31, comfortably inside the $750 budget (N5), achieved by right-sizing compute to Graviton, scaling instance count to real demand instead of static provisioning, and avoiding an oversized database tier. Sustainability: Graviton processors are more energy-efficient per request than comparable x86 instances, and scaling the fleet down to the true minimum of 2 instances for 670 of 730 hours per month avoids the Stage-3 pattern of running fixed capacity around the clock regardless of actual load, lowering compute-hours consumed per request served.",
  "comparison": "The original architecture served a small, roughly constant load: two t3.micro instances (80 rps real capacity), one NAT Gateway as a single point of outbound failure, a Multi-AZ RDS t3.micro pair with no caching layer, and static ASG bounds of 2-4 that were never load-tested against the new traffic. It would fail outright under the stated 750 rps peak and offered no formal RPO/RTO guarantee beyond generic Multi-AZ failover. Its $133.21 monthly bill reflected that small, non-elastic footprint -- it paid for fixed capacity 24/7 even though real demand varies roughly 10x across the day. The proposed architecture keeps the same core shape (ALB + ASG + RDS + S3 + CloudFront), minimizing re-architecture risk, but adds horizontal elasticity (2-4 Graviton m6g.large instances sized against measured rps-per-instance capacity), AZ-redundant NAT Gateways, an ElastiCache layer to protect the database at peak, and RDS/S3/CloudFront capacity sized to the stated N1 and N4 traffic figures, with explicit Multi-AZ failover and PITR to satisfy the N3 RPO/RTO targets. Monthly cost grows about 5x (to $672.31) while served capacity, availability, and recovery guarantees grow far more than 5x, so cost per request served falls substantially, and the design still clears the $750 budget with roughly $78 of monthly headroom for further growth or an optional read replica."

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Stage 2 (Quadrant B) - Photo-sharing website in a custom VPC (10.0.0.0/16) across two
  Availability Zones. A web server built from a reusable launch template with an Elastic IP
  in a public subnet, and an encrypted Amazon RDS for MySQL database in isolated private
  subnets. Region-agnostic, with no fixed resource names, so it can be deployed more than
  once per account and Region.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Web tier
        Parameters:
          - WebAmiId
          - AdminCidr
          - KeyName
      - Label:
          default: Database tier
        Parameters:
          - DBMasterUsername
          - DBName
    ParameterLabels:
      WebAmiId:
        default: Custom web server AMI ID (from the labs)
      AdminCidr:
        default: Administrators' network (CIDR) allowed to SSH
      KeyName:
        default: EC2 key pair for SSH (optional)
      DBMasterUsername:
        default: Database master username
      DBName:
        default: Initial database name

Parameters:
  WebAmiId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: ID of the custom AMI created in the labs. It must exist in the target Region.

  AdminCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block of the administrators' network, for example 203.0.113.0/24.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])/(3[0-2]|[12]?[0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block, for example 203.0.113.0/24.

  KeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of an existing EC2 key pair in this Region. Leave blank for none.

  DBMasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: dbadmin
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 16
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-16 characters. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores.
    Description: Master username for the MySQL database. The password is generated and stored in AWS Secrets Manager.

  DBName:
    Type: String
    Default: photos
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores.
    Description: Name of the initial database created on the RDS instance.

Conditions:
  HasKeyName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KeyName, ""]]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-2"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private route table: only the implicit local VPC route, so there is no path to the internet.
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web server - HTTP/HTTPS from anywhere, SSH from administrators only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTP from anywhere
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - Description: HTTPS from anywhere
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - Description: SSH from administrators' network
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Database - MySQL from the web server security group only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: MySQL from web servers only
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        KeyName: !If [HasKeyName, !Ref KeyName, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"
          - ResourceType: volume
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-volume"
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -x
            if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              # Amazon Linux 2023 / dnf-based images
              dnf install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd
            else
              # Amazon Linux 2 / yum-based images
              if command -v amazon-linux-extras >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                amazon-linux-extras enable php8.2 || amazon-linux-extras enable php8.0 || true
                yum clean metadata
              fi
              yum install -y httpd php php-mysqlnd
            fi
            systemctl enable httpd
            systemctl restart httpd
            if command -v php-fpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              systemctl enable php-fpm || true
              systemctl restart php-fpm || true
              systemctl restart httpd
            fi

  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: PublicDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  WebServerEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-eip"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database tier
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnets"

  Database:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: URL of the photo-sharing website
    Value: !Sub "http://${WebServerEIP}"

  WebServerPublicIP:
    Description: Fixed public IP address (Elastic IP) of the web server
    Value: !Ref WebServerEIP

  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint address of the RDS for MySQL database
    Value: !GetAtt Database.Endpoint.Address

  DatabasePort:
    Description: Port of the RDS for MySQL database
    Value: !GetAtt Database.Endpoint.Port

  DatabaseMasterSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret that holds the database master password
    Value: !GetAtt Database.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the custom VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  WebLaunchTemplateId:
    Description: ID of the reusable web server launch template
    Value: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 2 CloudFormation template with custom VPC, database tier, and launch template'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for web servers
  
  AdministratorCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for SSH administrator access
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0

Resources:
  # VPC with DNS support and hostnames enabled
  CustomVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDns64: false
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: CustomVPC

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: CustomIGW

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Table (no internet gateway route)
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Web Security Group
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web servers
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdministratorCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup

  # Database Security Group
  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref CustomVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DatabaseSecurityGroup

  # Launch Template
  WebServerLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: |
            #!/bin/bash
            yum update -y
            yum install -y httpd php php-mysql
            systemctl start httpd
            systemctl enable httpd
      TagSpecifications:
        - ResourceType: launch-template
          Tags:
            - Key: Name
              Value: WebServerLaunchTemplate

  # EC2 Instance in public subnet
  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebServer

  # Elastic IP
  WebServerElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebServerEIP

  # DB Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DBSubnetGroup

  # RDS MySQL Instance
  MySQLDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: customphoto-db
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0.35'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      DBName: photodb
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDatabase

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: Website URL using Elastic IP
    Value: !Sub 'http://${WebServerElasticIP}'

  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: RDS database endpoint address
    Value: !GetAtt MySQLDatabase.Endpoint.Address
```

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  DBMasterSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret

        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "admin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  # RDS MySQL Instance
  PhotoShareDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: photoshare-db
      Engine: mysql

      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'mon:04:00-mon:05:00'
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:

        - slowquery

    Value: !GetAtt PhotoShareDatabase.Endpoint.Address

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Photo-sharing website, Stage 2 - custom VPC, web tier launch template with Elastic IP, and private RDS for MySQL

Parameters:

    Description: Custom AMI ID for the web server (must include or permit installation of httpd and PHP)

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-2"

    Properties:

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier - HTTP/HTTPS from anywhere, SSH from admin CIDR only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443

        - IpProtocol: tcp

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Database tier - MySQL only from the web security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web tier
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        UserData: !Base64 |
          #!/bin/bash
          set -e
          yum install -y httpd php
          systemctl enable httpd
          systemctl start httpd
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"

  WebInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

    Properties:

        - Key: Name

    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt WebElasticIP.AllocationId
      InstanceId: !Ref WebInstance

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database tier
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-group"

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: !Ref DBInstanceClass
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      MultiAZ: false
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: URL of the photo-sharing website (Elastic IP)
    Value: !Sub "http://${WebElasticIP}"

  DatabaseEndpointAddress:
    Description: Address of the RDS for MySQL endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt DBInstance.Endpoint.Address

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 2 - Custom VPC, database tier and launch template for photo-sharing website'

Parameters:
  CustomAMI:

    Properties:

        - Key: Name

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoSharingIGW

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web servers
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: !Ref AdminCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for database
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DBSecurityGroup

  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: WebServerLaunchTemplate
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMI
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: |
            #!/bin/bash
            yum update -y
            yum install -y httpd php
            systemctl start httpd
            systemctl enable httpd

  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebServer

  ElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref WebServerInstance

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DBSubnetGroup

  RDSInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      Engine: mysql
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref DBMasterPassword
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoSharingDB

Outputs:
  WebsiteURL:
    Description: Website URL
    Value: !Sub 'http://${ElasticIP}'
  
  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: Database endpoint address
    Value: !GetAtt RDSInstance.Endpoint.Address

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Properties:

      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable

        - Key: Name

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

    Properties:

  PrivateRouteTable1:

    Properties:

        - Key: Name

  PrivateRouteTable2:

    Properties:

    Properties:

        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP from the internet to the Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from anywhere (CloudFront and viewers)
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg'

  WebServerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP to the web servers only from the Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

          ToPort: 3306

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 photo bucket (never public)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:

        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

      BucketEncryption:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Principal:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

            Statement:

                Action:

                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject

    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:

  # Application Load Balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb'

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200-399'
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '30'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-tg'

    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:

  # Web tier: launch template, Auto Scaling group, scaling policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:

        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        Monitoring:
          Enabled: true
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
          - ResourceType: volume
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: !Sub |
            #!/bin/bash
            # Expose stack-specific settings to the photo-sharing application
            cat > /etc/photo-app.env <<'EOF'
            PHOTO_BUCKET=${PhotoBucket}
            AWS_REGION=${AWS::Region}
            AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=${AWS::Region}
            DB_HOST=${Database.Endpoint.Address}
            DB_PORT=${Database.Endpoint.Port}
            DB_NAME=${DBName}
            DB_USER=${DBMasterUsername}
            EOF
            chmod 644 /etc/photo-app.env

    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateDefaultRoute1
      - PrivateDefaultRoute2
      - PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation
      - PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation
      - HttpListener
    UpdatePolicy:
      AutoScalingRollingUpdate:
        MinInstancesInService: 1
        MaxBatchSize: 1
        PauseTime: PT5M
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: '2'
      DesiredCapacity: '2'
      MaxSize: '4'
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      MetricsCollection:
        - Granularity: 1Minute
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  WebServerCpuScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebServerAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      EstimatedInstanceWarmup: 300
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 60

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database: Multi-AZ, encrypted RDS for MySQL with managed master password
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DatabaseSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo-sharing database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnets'

  Database:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      DBName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DatabaseSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      DeletionProtection: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront in front of the load balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub 'Photo-sharing website (${AWS::StackName})'
        HttpVersion: http2
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_All
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginReadTimeout: 30
              OriginKeepaliveTimeout: 5
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - PATCH
            - POST
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          # AWS managed policy: CachingDisabled (dynamic application)
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          # AWS managed policy: AllViewer (forward headers, cookies, query strings)
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn'

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name (use https://)
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the internet-facing Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
  PhotoBucketName:
    Description: Name of the private S3 bucket that stores uploaded photos
    Value: !Ref PhotoBucket
  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint address of the Multi-AZ RDS for MySQL database
    Value: !GetAtt Database.Endpoint.Address
  DatabaseSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the database master password
    Value: !GetAtt Database.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn

      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  ##########################################################################
  # Security Groups
  ##########################################################################

  ALBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTP from the internet to the ALB.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg'

  WebServerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound HTTP only from the ALB.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt ALBSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow inbound MySQL only from the web servers.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt WebServerSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  ##########################################################################
  # S3 photo storage
  ##########################################################################

  PhotosBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ##########################################################################
  # IAM role for web servers
  ##########################################################################

  WebServerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  WebServerInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebServerRole

  ##########################################################################
  # RDS MySQL (Multi-AZ, encrypted, managed password)
  ##########################################################################

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for RDS MySQL.
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: !Ref DBAllocatedStorage
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      DBName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !GetAtt DBSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7

  WebServerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-server-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebServerRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PhotoObjectAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub '${PhotosBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: ReadDBCredentials
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: !GetAtt DBInstance.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn

  ##########################################################################
  # Application Load Balancer
  ##########################################################################

  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref ALBSecurityGroup

  ALBTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref ALBTargetGroup

  ##########################################################################
  # Auto Scaling web tier
  ##########################################################################

  WebServerLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref WebServerAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebServerInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64:
            Fn::Sub: |
              #!/bin/bash
              cat <<EOF >> /etc/environment
              PHOTOS_BUCKET_NAME=${PhotosBucket}
              DB_HOST=${DBInstance.Endpoint.Address}
              DB_PORT=${DBInstance.Endpoint.Port}
              DB_NAME=${DBName}
              DB_USERNAME=${DBMasterUsername}
              DB_SECRET_ARN=${DBInstance.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn}
              AWS_REGION=${AWS::Region}
              EOF

  AutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebServerLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebServerLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: '2'
      MaxSize: '4'
      DesiredCapacity: '2'
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref ALBTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-server'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref AutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 60

  ##########################################################################
  # CloudFront distribution
  ##########################################################################

  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: ALBOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: ALBOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9d10-71b5f6e2a6e3
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name (HTTPS entry point).
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the internet-facing Application Load Balancer.
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Stage 3 Photo-sharing Website - Secure, Scalable, Highly Available Deployment'

Parameters:
  CustomAMIId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for web tier instances
  DatabaseMasterPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Master password for RDS MySQL (will be stored in Secrets Manager)
    MinLength: 8

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: "Instance Configuration"
        Parameters:
          - CustomAMIId
      - Label:
          default: "Database Configuration"
        Parameters:
          - DatabaseMasterPassword

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  PhotoVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoIGW

  AttachIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachIGW
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway
  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: AttachIGW
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGatewayEIP

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGateway

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RTAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security Groups
  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LoadBalancerSG

  WebInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for web tier instances
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebInstanceSG

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS database
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DatabaseSG

  # Application Load Balancer
  PhotoLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'photo-alb-${AWS::StackName}'
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoLoadBalancer

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'photo-tg-${AWS::StackName}'
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref PhotoVPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetType: instance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoTargetGroup

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref PhotoLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  # IAM Role and Instance Profile
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebInstanceRole

  S3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: S3PhotoBucketAccess
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # S3 Bucket for Photos
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'photo-bucket-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::StackName}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoBucket

  # Launch Template
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub 'photo-lt-${AWS::StackName}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAMIId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebInstanceSecurityGroup
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: PhotoWebInstance

  # Auto Scaling Group
  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub 'photo-asg-${AWS::StackName}'
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4
      DesiredCapacity: 2
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref TargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoWebInstance
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  # Target Tracking Scaling Policy
  CPUScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 70.0

  # RDS Database Subnet Group
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'photo-db-subnet-${AWS::StackName}'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Photo RDS database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDBSubnetGroup

  # Secrets Manager Secret for RDS Password
  RDSMasterSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'rds/photo/${AWS::StackName}/master'
      SecretString: !Sub |
        {
          "username": "admin",
          "password": "${DatabaseMasterPassword}"
        }

  # RDS MySQL Instance
  PhotoDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub 'photo-db-${AWS::StackName}'
      Engine: mysql
      EngineVersion: '8.0'
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: 20
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      MultiAZ: true
      MasterUsername: admin
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${RDSMasterSecret}:SecretString:password}}'
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      PreferredBackupWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: 'sun:04:00-sun:05:00'
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - error
        - general
        - slowquery
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PhotoDatabase

  # CloudFront Distribution
  PhotoCloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2
        Origins:
          - Id: LoadBalancerOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: true
            Cookies:
              Forward: all
            Headers:
              - '*'
          TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
        CacheBehaviors:
          - PathPattern: /health
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            CachedMethods:
              - GET
              - HEAD
            Compress: true
            ForwardedValues:
              QueryString: false
            TargetOriginId: LoadBalancerOrigin
            ViewerProtocolPolicy: allow-all
            DefaultTTL: 0
            MaxTTL: 0
            MinTTL: 0
        ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
        Comment: !Sub 'CloudFront distribution for ${AWS::StackName}'
        Logging:
          Bucket: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.DomainName
          Prefix: cloudfront-logs/
          IncludeCookies: false

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoCloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudFrontDomainName'

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: Application Load Balancer DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoLoadBalancer.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoadBalancerDNSName'
